text: Before Terraform runs, we plan exactly what it will create: two warehouses sized for two different workloads, one database, three schemas, and two roles.

LOAD_WH is an XSMALL warehouse that fast-suspends for the minute-by-minute merge Task. TRANSFORM_WH is one size up for scheduled dbt runs. Snowpipe itself uses Snowflake's own serverless compute, not either warehouse.
PINEHURST_DB holds three schemas: RAW, written only by the loader role; CURATED, readable for troubleshooting; and GOLD, the only schema any BI tool is allowed to query directly.
Two roles enforce that boundary structurally: LOADER_ROLE automates the pipeline, ANALYST_ROLE reads finished results -- and never sees a raw POS export.
